correctness.rationale: PASS, using a published integral-homology premise. The natural affine subgroup preserves tournament directions. The 2020 Govc order-23 classification has precisely one doubly regular tournament homotopy type with integral H₃≅Z²³⊕Z/23 and H₄≅Z⁴⁵. The independently enumerated Paley face counts are (23,253,1265,2530,1518), and all eleven exact F₂₃ cyclic-eigenspace boundary ranks were independently recomputed: ranks (∂₁,∂₂,∂₃)=(2,21,94) throughout, and ∂₄ rank 133 exactly for λ=1 and λ=12, rank 134 for nine others, yielding H₄(F₂₃) dimensions 5,5, and nine 4s. A second independent F₂ orbit-invariant calculation yielded ranks (2,21,94,133) and H₄(F₂)^C11 dimension 5. Since the integral H₄ is free rank45 and has no 2-primary UCT extra, rational C11 module is 5 trivial plus four cyclotomic 10-dimensional modules; reducing its free lattice mod23 gives free H₄(F₂₃) multiplicities 5 at λ1 and 4 elsewhere. The unique UCT Tor quotient from H₃[23] is therefore λ=12=2^{-1}. Every translation of order23 acts trivially on Aut(Z/23) of order22, yielding all affine multipliers. The exact eigen ranks are a complete finite certificate; Govc supplies rather than the verifier recertifying the integral torsion premise.
